about: Susan Klopman attended law school and graduated from University of Denver Sturm College of Law in 2001. Susan Klopman began practicing law in 2001.
Susan Klopman is an attorney at H&K Law, LLC, helping people with Employment & Labor: Employer issues. H&K Law, LLC has an office in Denver, Colorado, serving the local community.

Susan Klopman was selected to Super Lawyers for 2020 - 2027. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
